scenes.text: This guide is for people who register for a program or order from a business. You do not need an account.

scenes.title: Registering
scenes.text: Open the link or scan the QR code, and fill in the form. If an answer is missing or wrong, the problem is shown right under that question.

scenes.title: Ordering
scenes.text: When you order, add items to your cart, check the total, and confirm your order.

scenes.title: Your confirmation
scenes.text: You then get a registration or order number, and a copy you can preview, print or download.
